name: Asseco South Eastern Europe S.A.
summary: Asseco South Eastern Europe S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of its own and third-party software. The company operates through Banking Solutions, Payment Solutions, and Dedicated Solutions segments. It offers banking software solutions, including omnichannel solutions; integrated core banking systems; authentication security solutions; reporting systems for regulatory compliance and managerial information; and risk management and anti-fraud systems, as well as provides consultancy services in the area of digital banking and digital transformation. The company also provides payment industry solutions for financial and non-financial institutions supporting card and card-less transactions, which include e-commerce, mobile payments, payment card processing, as well as ATM and POS terminal related services. In addition, it engages in the development of IT infrastructure, continuity of business processes, automation of operations, and customized software development, as well as provision of implementations and support services. Further, the company offers proprietary solutions, such as live multi-functional customer service and sales support platform; ABC content management solution; and fidelity asset lifecycle management solution, as well as LeaseFlex, a lease and asset lifecycle management solution, and document management solutions. It serves in Central Europe, South Eastern Europe, Iberian Peninsula, Turkey, Colombia, Peru, and the Dominican Republic. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Asseco South Eastern Europe S.A. is a subsidiary of Asseco International a.s.
